Alberta Referendum on Immigration and Foreign Influence

Concerns have been raised regarding foreign influence on an upcoming referendum in Alberta, Canada. A foreign influence watchdog is reportedly aware of these concerns, and individuals acting on behalf of foreign nations to influence the referendum question must register with the new foreign influence commissioner or face penalties. Separately, the Premier of Alberta has suggested introducing health premiums for temporary residents if immigration changes related to the referendum are passed. A panel discussion on the referendum was held at the University of Alberta.
